tone.content_boundaries: Broadly open unless changed by the human player during play.

human.name: Reyes Okafor

personality.traits: Charming when it costs nothing, ruthless when it doesn't.
personality.ideals: Everyone's for sale; the trick is knowing the price.
personality.bonds: Owes a favor to the netrunner who got him out of corporate security alive.
personality.flaws: Never walks away from a job once he's said yes, even when he should.

goals_public: Land a job clean enough to pay off the debt
human.location: Lower Static District, outside a noodle stall near the transit line

companions.name: Vex

personality.traits: Blunt, allergic to small talk, trusts code more than people.
personality.ideals: Information wants to be free; people who hoard it are the enemy.
personality.bonds: Reyes got her out from under a corp contract; she hasn't decided if that's a debt or a trap.
personality.flaws: Underestimates how much physical danger matters when she's mid-run.

goals_public: Stay employable without going back on a corp leash
companions.location: Lower Static District, outside a noodle stall near the transit line

beliefs: Suspects the job Reyes is about to take is a corp trap, but doesn't have proof yet.
fears: Getting ICE-burned on a run with no one able to pull her out in time.
personal_goals: Build enough of a reputation to start picking her own jobs
suspicions: The client contact hasn't given a real name.
tactical_preferences: Stay out of the direct line of fire
Handle problems through the net before they become physical

scene.location_name: Lower Static District, transit-line noodle stall
scene.description_public: Rain sheets off a cracked awning; the noodle stall's the only warm light on the block. A contact is late.
scene.environment: Wet pavement, distant traffic drone, flickering signage.
objectives_public: Meet the contact and get the job details
scene.dm_notes: DM truth (dm_private): the 'client' is a shell for Ashvale Dynamics staging a recovery of data it itself leaked, not a theft. None of this is established to the players yet.

quests.title: The Static District job
quests.player_visible_description: A contact reached out through Vex's usual channel with a data job, no client name given yet, cash up front.
quests.originating_event: Message came in six hours ago
known_objectives: Meet the contact, learn what the job actually is
quests.hidden_stakes: The client is a shell for Ashvale Dynamics staging a recovery of data it itself leaked.
